reviews.review: Took the fishy with ugali - very tasty. first tried with fork and knife - no point in trying that, one can only use hands.. even got a fresh juice with no added sugar..

reviews.name: Sahal H.
reviews.review: Great food, although is was a delivery, the food was packaged very well. Their Mahamri and Samosas where delicious. You can tell they have used good and clean oils to fry the food as it was not tasting like the usual greasy and burn taste.d.

reviews.name: Claire Naserian.
reviews.review: My new go to Biriyani spot. Fresh food, great taste, great service.

faqs.question: Do you offer catering for events?
faqs.answer: Yes, we do! We offer catering services for corporate events, parties, and family gatherings, with a variety of Swahili dishes. Please contact us on WhatsApp at least a week in advance to discuss your requirements.

faqs.question: How does delivery work?
faqs.answer: We don't run our own delivery. For delivery to your door, order through our partners Uber Eats, Bolt Food or Glovo (links on our Contact page). Prefer takeaway? Message us on WhatsApp and we'll have your order ready for pickup.

faqs.question: Are there vegetarian/vegan options available?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have a variety of vegetarian and vegan dishes. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll share what's available today.

faqs.question: How is the food packaged for delivery?
faqs.answer: We use eco-friendly, insulated packaging to ensure your food arrives hot, fresh, and ready to eat, while also being kind to the environment.
